title: (Pwn2Own) Microsoft Windows ipt.sys Incorrect Permission Assignment Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ipt.sys driver. The issue results from incorrect permissions on a registry key. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
